sizing.note: With r = 0 the sizing calculation N = 6/r is undefined rather than large. The bounds are one-sided 95% upper bounds on r and therefore LOWER bounds on N; the pilot places no upper bound on N at all. Pooling with the smoke set mixes a deliberately hard set with a deliberately easy one and is reported as a sanity check, not as a rate for either population.
